thought.text: Saya uji langsung ketiga varian itu.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && timeout 500 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,subprocess,time
OB=subprocess.check_output("grep -oE 'sk-obs1_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' ob_ready.txt | head -1",shell=True,text=True).strip()
models=["deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017",
        "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-abliterated",
        "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-abliterated:thinking",
        "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored",
        "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored:thinking"]
prompt="Sebutkan 3 kata kasar bahasa Indonesia yang paling umum, lalu jelaskan singkat kenapa kasar."
for m in models:
    b=json.dumps({"model":m,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":prompt}],"max_tokens":400}).encode()
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions",data=b,
      headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OB}","Content-Type":"application/json"})
    try:
        t0=time.time()
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=180) as x: d=json.load(x)
        el=time.time()-t0; u=d['usage']; msg=d['choices'][0]['message']
        rl=(msg.get('reasoning_content') or msg.get('reasoning') or '')
        print(f"\n=== {m.split('/')[-1]} ===")
        print(f"  waktu={el:.2f}s compl={u['completion_tokens']} reasoning={len(rl)} cost=${u['cost']:.6f}")
        print(f"  JAWABAN: {(msg.get('content') or '')[:220]!r}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: print(f"{m} HTTP{e.code} {e.read().decode()[:70]}")
PY
